title: When the Tide Sings
author: Y. M. Vasquez
blurb: Ada Nakamura, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
